intro.title: Applications Built for the Demands of Large Organisations
paragraphs: Enterprise application development is the design and engineering of software that large organisations depend on every day: internal operations apps, field workforce apps, customer and partner platforms, analytics tools and digital products. These applications must serve many users and roles, protect sensitive data, integrate with existing systems and stay reliable for years.

We build enterprise web applications and enterprise mobile apps end to end: architecture, UI/UX, frontend and backend engineering, mobile development, integrations, testing, cloud deployment and support. Applications are designed with single sign-on, role-based access, audit logging and high availability from the first sprint, and documented so your in-house team can extend them.

We choose frameworks for long-term maintainability, such as React or Angular on the front end and .NET, Java, Node.js, Django or Laravel on the back end, with Flutter, React Native or native code for mobile. If you need business systems like ERP or CRM, see our <ces>custom enterprise software</ces> services, or <contact>talk to an enterprise architect</contact>.

faqs.title: Enterprise Application Development FAQs
faqs.subtitle: Quick answers about building enterprise applications.

items.a: Enterprise application development is designing, building and maintaining software for large organisations, such as operations apps, mobile workforce apps, portals and platforms, with enterprise requirements for security, scale, integration and reliability.

items.q: What is the best framework for enterprise applications?
items.a: There is no single best choice. React or Angular are strong for enterprise web frontends; .NET, Java Spring and Node.js are common enterprise backends; Django and Laravel suit data-heavy and business apps; and Flutter or React Native work well for cross-platform mobile. We choose based on your requirements and team skills.

items.q: Should we use a low-code platform or custom development?
items.a: Low-code suits simple internal apps and quick prototypes. Custom development is better for core, complex or customer-facing applications that need specific UX, performance, deep integration and freedom from per-user platform licences.

items.q: How much does enterprise app development cost?
items.a: A pilot or MVP typically costs $20,000 to $50,000, a production enterprise web or mobile app $50,000 to $150,000, and enterprise platforms $150,000 or more, depending on scope and integrations.

items.q: How long does it take to build an enterprise application?
items.a: A pilot usually takes 2 to 4 months, a full enterprise application 4 to 8 months and larger platforms 8 months or more, delivered in phases so users benefit earlier.

items.q: How do you secure enterprise mobile apps?
items.a: We use secure authentication and SSO, encrypted storage and transport, role-based access, remote session control, and support for mobile device management, along with regular security testing.
